subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Should the scanner trust exactly the provider/session reference shapes and three explicit test placeholders proposed by the linked PR?
rationale: These exceptions modify a fail-closed credential boundary, so the permanent allowlist needs explicit owner approval despite the narrow implementation shape.

options.title: Approve Exact Allowlist
options.body: Accept only the enumerated references and placeholders with paired negative tests for real literals and arbitrary references.

options.title: Narrow the Exceptions
options.body: Approve only independently verified cases and remove any reference or placeholder without a concrete safe use case.

options.title: Keep Current Boundary
options.body: Reject the exceptions and require downstream source or review-bundle changes around the flagged shapes.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact Allowlist
recommendation.body: Accept only the enumerated references and placeholders with paired negative tests for real literals and arbitrary references.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest source-reference and quoted-key boundary decisions in this scanner.
